preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and the second line contains n space-separated integers a_i (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for a in a_list if any(x < a for x in a_list) and any(x > a for x in a_list)))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of stewards with strength a_i such that there exists at least one steward with strictly less strength and at least one steward with strictly greater strength.
